description:
Price a whole design in one call and group it into the orders it would become. lines: [{"ref", "part": a part
    id} or {"ref", "text": "6811ZZ bearing"} (bought), or {"ref", "made": {"process", "material", "part": as
    quote_made_part takes it}} (made), each with "quantity" per build]. Each line's options: its offers or its shops'
    quotes; a text line says which part it matched and what else it might be. Nothing is chosen for you (update_bom).
    The chosen lines become carts (make_cart) and one quote a shop (quote_shop_order); `checkout` is start_checkout's
    arguments. Needs an API key.
name: price_bom
